# Blown leads of 11 runs or more

**10** games in Retrosheet's play-by-play era (1900–2025) in which a team led by 11 or more runs and then gave every run of it back. **8** of them lost; **2** recovered to win anyway.

An 11-run lead has been held in **6,006** of the **201,874** games with play-by-play, so it survives 99.8% of the time — the collapses below are about one in 601.

## Games I was at

- **Jul 18, 1994**, SLN @ HOU — St. Louis Cardinals led by 11 (11–0, 3rd); Houston Astros drew level in the 6th. Houston Astros won 15–12. Attendance 24,012.
- **Sep 4, 2002**, KCA @ OAK — Oakland Athletics led by 11 (11–0, 3rd); Kansas City Royals drew level in the 9th. Oakland Athletics won 12–11. Attendance 55,528.
